companies.name: NVIDIA
companies.summary: Revenue reached USD 96.221bn, 106% above the year-earlier quarter. GAAP gross margin was 75.0%.
facts: Revenue growth: Q2 FY27 sales were USD 96.221bn, up 106% year over year and 18% sequentially.
Data Center revenue: USD 89.0bn in Q2 FY27, up 117% year over year.
Revenue guidance: Q3 FY27 outlook was USD 108bn, with a 2% range either side; it excluded China Data Center compute sales.

companies.name: Tesla
companies.summary: Revenue was USD 28.236bn, up 26% year over year. GAAP operating margin was 1.4%; free cash flow was negative USD 1.092bn.
facts: Revenue growth: Q2 2026 sales were USD 28.236bn versus USD 22.496bn a year earlier, a 26% increase.
Operating margin: Q2 2026 GAAP operating margin was 1.4%, versus 4.1% in Q2 2025.
Free cash flow: Q2 2026 recorded negative USD 1.092bn. Vehicle deliveries totalled 480,126.

companies.name: Apple
companies.summary: Revenue was USD 114.5bn, up 12% year over year. Diluted EPS was USD 2.10, including USD 0.05 from tariff refunds.
facts: Revenue growth: Q4 FY26 revenue totalled USD 114.5bn, a 12% year-over-year increase.
Gross margin: Q4 FY26 margin was 47.9%, including about one percentage point of benefit from tariff refunds.
Earnings per share: Q4 FY26 diluted EPS was USD 2.10, including USD 0.05 from tariff refunds.

companies.name: Microsoft
companies.summary: Revenue was USD 92.3bn, up 19% year over year. Operating income was USD 45.9bn; Microsoft Cloud revenue was USD 63.9bn.
facts: Revenue growth: Q1 FY27 sales totalled USD 92.3bn, a 19% year-over-year increase.
Operating income: Q1 FY27 operating income was USD 45.9bn, up 21% year over year.
Cloud revenue: Microsoft Cloud generated USD 63.9bn in Q1 FY27, up 30% year over year.

companies.name: Jio Platforms
companies.summary: The issuer disclosure confirms subscriptions closed on 23 October and an issue price of INR 1,119. This is an IPO price, not a current market quote.
facts: IPO issue price: Jio Platforms finalised INR 1,119 per share on 24 October 2026.
IPO subscription dates: the offer opened on 21 October 2026 and closed on 23 October 2026. Listing status requires a separate exchange notice.
